title: MODRIC, 41, IS LEVEL WITH MESSI ON 208 CAPS. RETIREMENT? NO.
description:
Forty-one, 208 caps and still turning down retirement. Luka Modric won't be hurried.

Croatia's captain has just won his 208th cap, level with Messi. Only Cristiano Ronaldo has more, with 234. Croatia had lost four in a row, a first ever, then beat Czechia 2-1 in Osijek, and Modric played all ninety as captain. Cristiano, check your mirrors.

Since August he's played 19 of 21 matches. The calendar wants a rest. He doesn't. He reached 50 Milan appearances in a 2-1 win at Genoa, and next up is Frosinone, his 227th different opponent, says Gazzetta. At this rate he'll have played everyone.

One more year or a few more? How long should Modric keep going? Your call.
